facts.finding: Preview requires plan.authorization_ref and errors before new authorization when absent.
Grant interpretation checks plan current pointer; confirm rejects enabled and overwrites pointer.
Current permit requires paused/manual/current grant, current UI/Host/epoch and one finite run.
Claim and final POST still check current plan grant and non-automatic Host identity.
Rerun is denied and complete never rerun is unconditionally expired in current phase.
Candidate confirm rerun denied; Host readiness observation lacks rerun command.
No rerun receipt observation currently exists.
Existing original outbox preparation transaction and three-target directory preparation reusable.

decision.scope: single-run grant separation + immediate run for enabled/paused/completed + independent current-config rerun
decision.reason: New explicit purpose proof distinguishes single-run grants while retaining the single existing quota ledger and automatic plan authority. No legacy backfill.

review.type: self review separate from drafting; no subagents or independent human approval
scenarios: completed once immediate run remains completed
rerun preview differences and stale revision
request replay/unknown separate grant and run receipts
last occupied debit and no second charge
current rerun must not be expired by old cleanup
unknown requires trusted release and retains old result/hold
background startup cannot rebuild one-time UI permit
automatic due tick busy skip remains independent
old trigger facts format kept readable
no snapshot or deleted chat resurrection
